cluster_pattern.structural_property: This round's real finding is PROCEDURAL, not scientific: writing a target under a truncated, abbreviated, or otherwise non-exact run_id string produces a citation that reads correctly to a human but is INVISIBLE to any automated coverage check (including this very backlog sweep's own pending_review.md blind-spot net) -- the run silently re-enters the 'never autopsied' pool despite having been correctly diagnosed, sometimes months earlier. This is the identical failure mode the skill's 'reviewed != manifest-corrected' warning describes, one level up: 'targeted != actually-matchable'.
